steps.label: Apply a gate, check an eigenvector
Prove unitarity
steps.sub: U @ U.conj().T == I — the single most important gate check

code:
X = np.array([[0, 1], [1, 0]])
plus = np.array([1, 1]) / np.sqrt(2)

result = X @ plus
# [0.70710678 0.70710678]

np.allclose(result, plus)
# True
caption: == is unreliable for floats; np.allclose checks "close enough within tolerance" instead.

eyebrow: The unitarity check, on a complex gate
code:
Y = np.array([[0, -1j], [1j, 0]])

check = Y @ Y.conj().T
# [[1.+0.j 0.+0.j]
#  [0.+0.j 1.+0.j]]

np.allclose(check, np.eye(2))
# True
caption: Pauli-Y passes U @ U.conj().T == I despite its complex entries — a physically valid quantum gate.
